name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset
description:
AI-callable tools for UEFN Creative devices — classic Blueprint and Verse creative_device. Browse the
project's placeable device catalog, place devices, add or remove event bindings between placed devices,
and read or write a Verse device's settings.

tools.description: Set one editable setting on a Verse creative_device.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.SetDeviceProperty

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

value.description: JSON-encoded value for the setting's type (e.g. 5, true, "text", {"X":1}).

tools.description: Remove an event binding from a source device's event to a target device's function.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.RemoveEventBinding

sourceDevicePath.title: /Script/CoreUObject.Object
sourceDevicePath.description: Object path of the source device actor.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

sourceEvent.description: Event name on the source device.

targetDevicePath.title: /Script/CoreUObject.Object
targetDevicePath.description: Object path of the target device actor.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

targetFunction.description: Function name on the target device.

tools.description: Place a catalog device (classic or Verse) into the level.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.PlaceDevice

assetPath.title: /Script/CoreUObject.Object
assetPath.description: A device asset reference (from the catalog).

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

transform.title: ToolsetTransform
transform.description: World-space transform to place the device with; scale is applied after spawn.

returnValue.title: /Script/CoreUObject.Object
returnValue.description: Object path of the placed device actor.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

tools.description: List the event bindings currently wired into a device's target functions.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.ListEventBindings

devicePath.title: /Script/CoreUObject.Object
devicePath.description: Object path of the device actor.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

sourceDevicePath.title: /Script/CoreUObject.Object
sourceDevicePath.description: Object path of the source device that emits the event.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

sourceEvent.description: Source event name on the source device.

tools.description: List a Verse creative_device's editable settings as a JSON property schema, with friendly names.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.ListDeviceProperties

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

returnValue.description: JSON Schema of the editable settings.

tools.description: List the project's placeable Creative devices — classic (Blueprint) and Verse (creative_device).
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.ListDeviceAssets

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against each device's asset name. Empty lists all.

assetPath.description: Object path of the device asset.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

category.description: Device category label (e.g. "Gameplay"). Empty for a Verse device.

bIsVerseDevice.description: True for a Verse creative_device; false for a classic Blueprint device.

tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.DeviceToolset.GetDeviceProperties

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

returnValue.description: JSON object of values, keyed by the requested names.

devicePath.description: Object path of the device actor.
